  // node_modules/delaunator/index.js
  var EPSILON = Math.pow(2, -52);
  var EDGE_STACK = new Uint32Array(512);
  var Delaunator = class _Delaunator {
    /**
     * Constructs a delaunay triangulation object given an array of points (`[x, y]` by default).
     * `getX` and `getY` are optional functions of the form `(point) => value` for custom point formats.
     *
     * @template P
     * @param {P[]} points
     * @param {(p: P) => number} [getX]
     * @param {(p: P) => number} [getY]
     */
    // @ts-expect-error TS2322
    static from(points, getX = defaultGetX, getY = defaultGetY) {
      const n2 = points.length;
      const coords = new Float64Array(n2 * 2);
      for (let i2 = 0; i2 < n2; i2++) {
        const p2 = points[i2];
        coords[2 * i2] = getX(p2);
        coords[2 * i2 + 1] = getY(p2);
      }
      return new _Delaunator(coords);
    }
    /**
     * Constructs a delaunay triangulation object given an array of point coordinates of the form:
     * `[x0, y0, x1, y1, ...]` (use a typed array for best performance). Duplicate points are skipped.
     *
     * @param {T} coords
     */
    constructor(coords) {
      const n2 = coords.length >> 1;
      if (n2 > 0 && typeof coords[0] !== "number") throw new Error("Expected coords to contain numbers.");
      this.coords = coords;
      const maxTriangles = Math.max(2 * n2 - 5, 0);
      this._triangles = new Uint32Array(maxTriangles * 3);
      this._halfedges = new Int32Array(maxTriangles * 3);
      this._hashSize = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(n2));
      this._hullPrev = new Uint32Array(n2);
      this._hullNext = new Uint32Array(n2);
      this._hullTri = new Uint32Array(n2);
      this._hullHash = new Int32Array(this._hashSize);
      this._ids = new Uint32Array(n2);
      this._dists = new Float64Array(n2);
      this.trianglesLen = 0;
      this._cx = 0;
      this._cy = 0;
      this._hullStart = 0;
      this.hull = this._triangles;
      this.triangles = this._triangles;
      this.halfedges = this._halfedges;
      this.update();
    }
    /**
     * Updates the triangulation if you modified `delaunay.coords` values in place, avoiding expensive memory allocations.
     * Useful for iterative relaxation algorithms such as Lloyd's.
     */
    update() {
      const { coords, _hullPrev: hullPrev, _hullNext: hullNext, _hullTri: hullTri, _hullHash: hullHash } = this;
      const n2 = coords.length >> 1;
      let minX = Infinity;
      let minY = Infinity;
      let maxX = -Infinity;
      let maxY = -Infinity;
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < n2; i3++) {
        const x2 = coords[2 * i3];
        const y2 = coords[2 * i3 + 1];
        if (x2 < minX) minX = x2;
        if (y2 < minY) minY = y2;
        if (x2 > maxX) maxX = x2;
        if (y2 > maxY) maxY = y2;
        this._ids[i3] = i3;
      }
      const cx = (minX + maxX) / 2;
      const cy = (minY + maxY) / 2;
      let i0 = 0, i1 = 0, i2 = 0;
      for (let i3 = 0, minDist = Infinity; i3 < n2; i3++) {
        const d2 = dist(cx, cy, coords[2 * i3], coords[2 * i3 + 1]);
        if (d2 < minDist) {
          i0 = i3;
          minDist = d2;
        }
      }
      const i0x = coords[2 * i0];
      const i0y = coords[2 * i0 + 1];
      for (let i3 = 0, minDist = Infinity; i3 < n2; i3++) {
        if (i3 === i0) continue;
        const d2 = dist(i0x, i0y, coords[2 * i3], coords[2 * i3 + 1]);
        if (d2 < minDist && d2 > 0) {
          i1 = i3;
          minDist = d2;
        }
      }
      let i1x = coords[2 * i1];
      let i1y = coords[2 * i1 + 1];
      let minRadius = Infinity;
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < n2; i3++) {
        if (i3 === i0 || i3 === i1) continue;
        const r2 = circumradius(i0x, i0y, i1x, i1y, coords[2 * i3], coords[2 * i3 + 1]);
        if (r2 < minRadius) {
          i2 = i3;
          minRadius = r2;
        }
      }
      let i2x = coords[2 * i2];
      let i2y = coords[2 * i2 + 1];
      if (minRadius === Infinity) {
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < n2; i3++) {
          this._dists[i3] = coords[2 * i3] - coords[0] || coords[2 * i3 + 1] - coords[1];
        }
        quicksort(this._ids, this._dists, 0, n2 - 1);
        const hull = new Uint32Array(n2);
        let j2 = 0;
        for (let i3 = 0, d0 = -Infinity; i3 < n2; i3++) {
          const id = this._ids[i3];
          const d2 = this._dists[id];
          if (d2 > d0) {
            hull[j2++] = id;
            d0 = d2;
          }
        }
        this.hull = hull.subarray(0, j2);
        this.triangles = new Uint32Array(0);
        this.halfedges = new Int32Array(0);
        return;
      }
      if (orient2d(i0x, i0y, i1x, i1y, i2x, i2y) < 0) {
        const i3 = i1;
        const x2 = i1x;
        const y2 = i1y;
        i1 = i2;
        i1x = i2x;
        i1y = i2y;
        i2 = i3;
        i2x = x2;
        i2y = y2;
      }
      const center = circumcenter(i0x, i0y, i1x, i1y, i2x, i2y);
      this._cx = center.x;
      this._cy = center.y;
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < n2; i3++) {
        this._dists[i3] = dist(coords[2 * i3], coords[2 * i3 + 1], center.x, center.y);
      }
      quicksort(this._ids, this._dists, 0, n2 - 1);
      this._hullStart = i0;
      let hullSize = 3;
      hullNext[i0] = hullPrev[i2] = i1;
      hullNext[i1] = hullPrev[i0] = i2;
      hullNext[i2] = hullPrev[i1] = i0;
      hullTri[i0] = 0;
      hullTri[i1] = 1;
      hullTri[i2] = 2;
      hullHash.fill(-1);
      hullHash[this._hashKey(i0x, i0y)] = i0;
      hullHash[this._hashKey(i1x, i1y)] = i1;
      hullHash[this._hashKey(i2x, i2y)] = i2;
      this.trianglesLen = 0;
      this._addTriangle(i0, i1, i2, -1, -1, -1);
      for (let k2 = 0, xp = 0, yp = 0; k2 < this._ids.length; k2++) {
        const i3 = this._ids[k2];
        const x2 = coords[2 * i3];
        const y2 = coords[2 * i3 + 1];
        if (k2 > 0 && Math.abs(x2 - xp) <= EPSILON && Math.abs(y2 - yp) <= EPSILON) continue;
        xp = x2;
        yp = y2;
        if (i3 === i0 || i3 === i1 || i3 === i2) continue;
        let start = 0;
        for (let j2 = 0, key = this._hashKey(x2, y2); j2 < this._hashSize; j2++) {
          start = hullHash[(key + j2) % this._hashSize];
          if (start !== -1 && start !== hullNext[start]) break;
        }
        start = hullPrev[start];
        let e2 = start, q2;
        while (q2 = hullNext[e2], orient2d(x2, y2, coords[2 * e2], coords[2 * e2 + 1], coords[2 * q2], coords[2 * q2 + 1]) >= 0) {
          e2 = q2;
          if (e2 === start) {
            e2 = -1;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (e2 === -1) continue;
        let t2 = this._addTriangle(e2, i3, hullNext[e2], -1, -1, hullTri[e2]);
        hullTri[i3] = this._legalize(t2 + 2);
        hullTri[e2] = t2;
        hullSize++;
        let n3 = hullNext[e2];
        while (q2 = hullNext[n3], orient2d(x2, y2, coords[2 * n3], coords[2 * n3 + 1], coords[2 * q2], coords[2 * q2 + 1]) < 0) {
          t2 = this._addTriangle(n3, i3, q2, hullTri[i3], -1, hullTri[n3]);
          hullTri[i3] = this._legalize(t2 + 2);
          hullNext[n3] = n3;
          hullSize--;
          n3 = q2;
        }
        if (e2 === start) {
          while (q2 = hullPrev[e2], orient2d(x2, y2, coords[2 * q2], coords[2 * q2 + 1], coords[2 * e2], coords[2 * e2 + 1]) < 0) {
            t2 = this._addTriangle(q2, i3, e2, -1, hullTri[e2], hullTri[q2]);
            this._legalize(t2 + 2);
            hullTri[q2] = t2;
            hullNext[e2] = e2;
            hullSize--;
            e2 = q2;
          }
        }
        this._hullStart = hullPrev[i3] = e2;
        hullNext[e2] = hullPrev[n3] = i3;
        hullNext[i3] = n3;
        hullHash[this._hashKey(x2, y2)] = i3;
        hullHash[this._hashKey(coords[2 * e2], coords[2 * e2 + 1])] = e2;
      }
      this.hull = new Uint32Array(hullSize);
      for (let i3 = 0, e2 = this._hullStart; i3 < hullSize; i3++) {
        this.hull[i3] = e2;
        e2 = hullNext[e2];
      }
      this.triangles = this._triangles.subarray(0, this.trianglesLen);
      this.halfedges = this._halfedges.subarray(0, this.trianglesLen);
    }
    /**
     * Calculate an angle-based key for the edge hash used for advancing convex hull.
     *
     * @param {number} x
     * @param {number} y
     * @private
     */
    _hashKey(x2, y2) {
      return Math.floor(pseudoAngle(x2 - this._cx, y2 - this._cy) * this._hashSize) % this._hashSize;
    }
    /**
     * Flip an edge in a pair of triangles if it doesn't satisfy the Delaunay condition.
     *
     * @param {number} a
     * @private
     */
    _legalize(a2) {
      const { _triangles: triangles2, _halfedges: halfedges, coords } = this;
      let i2 = 0;
      let ar2 = 0;
      while (true) {
        const b2 = halfedges[a2];
        const a0 = a2 - a2 % 3;
        ar2 = a0 + (a2 + 2) % 3;
        if (b2 === -1) {
          if (i2 === 0) break;
          a2 = EDGE_STACK[--i2];
          continue;
        }
        const b0 = b2 - b2 % 3;
        const al = a0 + (a2 + 1) % 3;
        const bl = b0 + (b2 + 2) % 3;
        const p0 = triangles2[ar2];
        const pr2 = triangles2[a2];
        const pl = triangles2[al];
        const p1 = triangles2[bl];
        const illegal = inCircle(
          coords[2 * p0],
          coords[2 * p0 + 1],
          coords[2 * pr2],
          coords[2 * pr2 + 1],
          coords[2 * pl],
          coords[2 * pl + 1],
          coords[2 * p1],
          coords[2 * p1 + 1]
        );
        if (illegal) {
          triangles2[a2] = p1;
          triangles2[b2] = p0;
          const hbl = halfedges[bl];
          if (hbl === -1) {
            let e2 = this._hullStart;
            do {
              if (this._hullTri[e2] === bl) {
                this._hullTri[e2] = a2;
                break;
              }
              e2 = this._hullPrev[e2];
            } while (e2 !== this._hullStart);
          }
          this._link(a2, hbl);
          this._link(b2, halfedges[ar2]);
          this._link(ar2, bl);
          const br2 = b0 + (b2 + 1) % 3;
          if (i2 < EDGE_STACK.length) {
            EDGE_STACK[i2++] = br2;
          }
        } else {
          if (i2 === 0) break;
          a2 = EDGE_STACK[--i2];
        }
      }
      return ar2;
    }
    /**
     * Link two half-edges to each other.
     * @param {number} a
     * @param {number} b
     * @private
     */
    _link(a2, b2) {
      this._halfedges[a2] = b2;
      if (b2 !== -1) this._halfedges[b2] = a2;
    }
    /**
     * Add a new triangle given vertex indices and adjacent half-edge ids.
     *
     * @param {number} i0
     * @param {number} i1
     * @param {number} i2
     * @param {number} a
     * @param {number} b
     * @param {number} c
     * @private
     */
    _addTriangle(i0, i1, i2, a2, b2, c2) {
      const t2 = this.trianglesLen;
      this._triangles[t2] = i0;
      this._triangles[t2 + 1] = i1;
      this._triangles[t2 + 2] = i2;
      this._link(t2, a2);
      this._link(t2 + 1, b2);
      this._link(t2 + 2, c2);
      this.trianglesLen += 3;
      return t2;
    }
  };
  function pseudoAngle(dx, dy) {
    const p2 = dx / (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy));
    return (dy > 0 ? 3 - p2 : 1 + p2) / 4;
  }
  function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) {
    const dx = ax - bx;
    const dy = ay - by;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy;
  }
  function inCircle(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, px, py) {
    const dx = ax - px;
    const dy = ay - py;
    const ex = bx - px;
    const ey = by - py;
    const fx = cx - px;
    const fy = cy - py;
    const ap = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    const bp = ex * ex + ey * ey;
    const cp = fx * fx + fy * fy;
    return dx * (ey * cp - bp * fy) - dy * (ex * cp - bp * fx) + ap * (ex * fy - ey * fx) < 0;
  }
  function circumradius(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy) {
    const dx = bx - ax;
    const dy = by - ay;
    const ex = cx - ax;
    const ey = cy - ay;
    const bl = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    const cl = ex * ex + ey * ey;
    const d2 = 0.5 / (dx * ey - dy * ex);
    const x2 = (ey * bl - dy * cl) * d2;
    const y2 = (dx * cl - ex * bl) * d2;
    return x2 * x2 + y2 * y2;
  }
  function circumcenter(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy) {
    const dx = bx - ax;
    const dy = by - ay;
    const ex = cx - ax;
    const ey = cy - ay;
    const bl = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    const cl = ex * ex + ey * ey;
    const d2 = 0.5 / (dx * ey - dy * ex);
    const x2 = ax + (ey * bl - dy * cl) * d2;
    const y2 = ay + (dx * cl - ex * bl) * d2;
    return { x: x2, y: y2 };
  }
  function quicksort(ids, dists, left, right) {
    if (right - left <= 20) {
      for (let i2 = left + 1; i2 <= right; i2++) {
        const temp = ids[i2];
        const tempDist = dists[temp];
        let j2 = i2 - 1;
        while (j2 >= left && dists[ids[j2]] > tempDist) ids[j2 + 1] = ids[j2--];
        ids[j2 + 1] = temp;
      }
    } else {
      const median = left + right >> 1;
      let i2 = left + 1;
      let j2 = right;
      swap(ids, median, i2);
      if (dists[ids[left]] > dists[ids[right]]) swap(ids, left, right);
      if (dists[ids[i2]] > dists[ids[right]]) swap(ids, i2, right);
      if (dists[ids[left]] > dists[ids[i2]]) swap(ids, left, i2);
      const temp = ids[i2];
      const tempDist = dists[temp];
      while (true) {
        do
          i2++;
        while (dists[ids[i2]] < tempDist);
        do
          j2--;
        while (dists[ids[j2]] > tempDist);
        if (j2 < i2) break;
        swap(ids, i2, j2);
      }
      ids[left + 1] = ids[j2];
      ids[j2] = temp;
      if (right - i2 + 1 >= j2 - left) {
        quicksort(ids, dists, i2, right);
        quicksort(ids, dists, left, j2 - 1);
      } else {
        quicksort(ids, dists, left, j2 - 1);
        quicksort(ids, dists, i2, right);
      }
    }
  }
  function swap(arr, i2, j2) {
    const tmp = arr[i2];
    arr[i2] = arr[j2];
    arr[j2] = tmp;
  }
  function defaultGetX(p2) {
    return p2[0];
  }
  function defaultGetY(p2) {
    return p2[1];
  }

  // node_modules/d3-delaunay/src/path.js
  var epsilon2 = 1e-6;
  var Path = class {
    constructor() {
      this._x0 = this._y0 = // start of current subpath
      this._x1 = this._y1 = null;
      this._ = "";
    }
    moveTo(x2, y2) {
      this._ += `M${this._x0 = this._x1 = +x2},${this._y0 = this._y1 = +y2}`;
    }
    closePath() {
      if (this._x1 !== null) {
        this._x1 = this._x0, this._y1 = this._y0;
        this._ += "Z";
      }
    }
    lineTo(x2, y2) {
      this._ += `L${this._x1 = +x2},${this._y1 = +y2}`;
    }
    arc(x2, y2, r2) {
      x2 = +x2, y2 = +y2, r2 = +r2;
      const x0 = x2 + r2;
      const y0 = y2;
      if (r2 < 0) throw new Error("negative radius");
      if (this._x1 === null) this._ += `M${x0},${y0}`;
      else if (Math.abs(this._x1 - x0) > epsilon2 || Math.abs(this._y1 - y0) > epsilon2) this._ += "L" + x0 + "," + y0;
      if (!r2) return;
      this._ += `A${r2},${r2},0,1,1,${x2 - r2},${y2}A${r2},${r2},0,1,1,${this._x1 = x0},${this._y1 = y0}`;
    }
    rect(x2, y2, w3, h2) {
      this._ += `M${this._x0 = this._x1 = +x2},${this._y0 = this._y1 = +y2}h${+w3}v${+h2}h${-w3}Z`;
    }
    value() {
      return this._ || null;
    }
  };

  // node_modules/d3-delaunay/src/polygon.js
  var Polygon = class {
    constructor() {
      this._ = [];
    }
    moveTo(x2, y2) {
      this._.push([x2, y2]);
    }
    closePath() {
      this._.push(this._[0].slice());
    }
    lineTo(x2, y2) {
      this._.push([x2, y2]);
    }
    value() {
      return this._.length ? this._ : null;
    }
  };

  // node_modules/d3-delaunay/src/voronoi.js
  var Voronoi = class {
    constructor(delaunay, [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] = [0, 0, 960, 500]) {
      if (!((xmax = +xmax) >= (xmin = +xmin)) || !((ymax = +ymax) >= (ymin = +ymin))) throw new Error("invalid bounds");
      this.delaunay = delaunay;
      this._circumcenters = new Float64Array(delaunay.points.length * 2);
      this.vectors = new Float64Array(delaunay.points.length * 2);
      this.xmax = xmax, this.xmin = xmin;
      this.ymax = ymax, this.ymin = ymin;
      this._init();
    }
    update() {
      this.delaunay.update();
      this._init();
      return this;
    }
    _init() {
      const { delaunay: { points, hull, triangles: triangles2 }, vectors } = this;
      let bx, by;
      const circumcenters = this.circumcenters = this._circumcenters.subarray(0, triangles2.length / 3 * 2);
      for (let i2 = 0, j2 = 0, n2 = triangles2.length, x2, y2; i2 < n2; i2 += 3, j2 += 2) {
        const t1 = triangles2[i2] * 2;
        const t2 = triangles2[i2 + 1] * 2;
        const t3 = triangles2[i2 + 2] * 2;
        const x12 = points[t1];
        const y12 = points[t1 + 1];
        const x22 = points[t2];
        const y22 = points[t2 + 1];
        const x3 = points[t3];
        const y3 = points[t3 + 1];
        const dx = x22 - x12;
        const dy = y22 - y12;
        const ex = x3 - x12;
        const ey = y3 - y12;
        const ab4 = (dx * ey - dy * ex) * 2;
        if (Math.abs(ab4) < 1e-9) {
          if (bx === void 0) {
            bx = by = 0;
            for (const i3 of hull) bx += points[i3 * 2], by += points[i3 * 2 + 1];
            bx /= hull.length, by /= hull.length;

  function normalizeModel(object, targetWidth) {

  function loadArrayBuffer(url) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.open("GET", url, true);
      xhr.responseType = "arraybuffer";
      xhr.onload = () => {
        if (xhr.status === 0 || xhr.status === 200) resolve(xhr.response);
        else reject(new Error("xhr status " + xhr.status + " for " + url));
      };
      xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error("xhr network error for " + url));
      xhr.ontimeout = () => reject(new Error("xhr timeout for " + url));
      xhr.send();
    });
  }
  async function buildTemplate(id) {
    const def = FILTERS[id];
    if (!def) throw new Error("unknown filter " + id);
    let object;
    if (def.url) {
      const resolvedUrl = new URL(def.url, location.href).href;
      rnPost({ type: "debug", message: "loading filter " + id + " from " + resolvedUrl });
      let buffer;
      try {
        buffer = await loadArrayBuffer(resolvedUrl);
      } catch (e2) {
        throw new Error("fetch " + resolvedUrl + " failed: " + (e2 && e2.message || e2));
      }
      const gltf = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        gltfLoader.parse(buffer, resolvedUrl, resolve, reject);
      });
      object = gltf.scene || gltf.scenes[0];
    } else if (def.build) {
      object = def.build();
    } else {
      throw new Error("filter " + id + " has neither url nor build");
    }
    if (def.rotate) {
      object.rotation.set(def.rotate[0], def.rotate[1], def.rotate[2]);
      object.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    }
    return normalizeModel(object, def.width);
  }

    if (modelTemplates[id]) return Promise.resolve(modelTemplates[id]);
    if (modelLoadPromises[id]) return modelLoadPromises[id];
    const promise = buildTemplate(id).then((template) => {
      delete modelLoadPromises[id];
      if (isDestroyed()) return null;
      modelTemplates[id] = template;
      rnPost({ type: "filterReady", id });
      return template;
    }).catch((e2) => {
      delete modelLoadPromises[id];
      if (!isDestroyed()) rnPost({ type: "filterError", id, message: String(e2 && e2.message || e2) });
      throw e2;
    });
    modelLoadPromises[id] = promise;
    return promise;
  }
  function disposeObject3D(root) {
    if (!root) return;
    root.traverse((obj) => {
      if (obj.geometry) obj.geometry.dispose();
      const mats = Array.isArray(obj.material) ? obj.material : obj.material ? [obj.material] : [];
      for (const mat of mats) {
        for (const key of Object.keys(mat)) {
          const value = mat[key];
          if (value && value.isTexture) value.dispose();
        }
        mat.dispose();
      }
    });
  }
  function markFilterOwned(root, id) {
    root.traverse((obj) => {
      obj.userData.filterOwned = true;
      obj.userData.filterId = id;
    });
  }
  function clearActiveFilter() {
    const found = [];
    scene.traverse((obj) => {
      if (obj.userData && obj.userData.filterOwned === true) found.push(obj);
    });
    const markedSet = new Set(found);
    const roots = found.filter((obj) => !obj.parent || !markedSet.has(obj.parent));
    rnPost({
      type: "diag",
      stage: "clearActiveFilter-before",
      activeFilterId: currentFilter,
      filterOwnedObjectsFound: found.length,
      filterOwnedRootsFound: roots.length
    });
    const removedLog = roots.map((obj) => ({
      name: obj.name || obj.type || "(unnamed)",
      parentName: obj.parent ? obj.parent.name || obj.parent.type || "(unnamed)" : "(none)",
      filterId: obj.userData.filterId
    }));
    for (const obj of roots) {
      if (obj.parent) obj.parent.remove(obj);
    }
    filterRoot.visible = false;
    clearFace2DFilter();
    if (occluderMesh) occluderMesh.visible = false;
    if (agingMesh) agingMesh.visible = false;
    setAgingBackdropVisible(false);
    let remaining = 0;
    scene.traverse((obj) => {
      if (obj.userData && obj.userData.filterOwned === true) remaining++;
    });
    rnPost({
      type: "diag",
      stage: "clearActiveFilter-after",
      activeFilterId: currentFilter,
      removed: removedLog,
      filterOwnedRemaining: remaining
    });
    renderer.clear(true, true, true);
    renderer.render(scene, camera3);
    renderDiagFramesRemaining = 3;
  }
  var filterRequestVersion = 0;
  async function showFilter(id) {
    currentFilter = id;
    const myVersion = ++filterRequestVersion;
    clearActiveFilter();
    const def = FILTERS[id];
    if (def && def.kind === "aging") {
      const isReady = await activateFace2DFilter("grandpa");
      if (!isReady || isDestroyed() || myVersion !== filterRequestVersion) return;
      rnPost({ type: "filterReady", id });
      return;
    }
    if (def && def.kind === "landmark2d") {
      const isReady = await activateFace2DFilter(id);
      if (!isReady || isDestroyed() || myVersion !== filterRequestVersion) return;
      rnPost({ type: "filterReady", id });
      return;
    }
    let template;
    try {
      template = await loadTemplate(id);
    } catch (e2) {
      return;
    }
    if (isDestroyed() || myVersion !== filterRequestVersion) return;
    clearActiveFilter();
    if (template) {
      const instance = template.clone(true);
      markFilterOwned(instance, id);
      filterRoot.add(instance);
    }
  }
  function buildCrownModel() {
    const group = new Group();
    const goldParts = [];
    const bandProfile = [];
    for (let i2 = 0; i2 <= 24; i2++) {
      const t2 = i2 / 24;
      bandProfile.push(new Vector2(0.5 + 0.035 * Math.sin(t2 * Math.PI), t2 * 0.34));
    }
    const band = new LatheGeometry(bandProfile, 48);
    goldParts.push(band);
    for (let i2 = 0; i2 < 8; i2++) {
      const a2 = i2 / 8 * Math.PI * 2;
      const tall = i2 % 2 === 0;
      const spike = new ConeGeometry(tall ? 0.085 : 0.06, tall ? 0.34 : 0.22, 12);
      spike.translate(0, (tall ? 0.34 : 0.22) / 2 + 0.33, 0);
      spike.translate(Math.cos(a2) * 0.47, 0, Math.sin(a2) * 0.47);
      goldParts.push(spike);
    }
    const rimTop = new TorusGeometry(0.5, 0.028, 12, 48);
    rimTop.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    rimTop.translate(0, 0.34, 0);
    const rimBase = new TorusGeometry(0.52, 0.035, 12, 48);
    rimBase.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    rimBase.translate(0, 0.01, 0);
    goldParts.push(rimTop, rimBase);
    const goldGeo = mergeGeometries(goldParts, false);
    const gold = new Mesh(goldGeo, new MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 15250506,
      metalness: 0.9,
      roughness: 0.28
    }));
    group.add(gold);
    const gemA = [], gemB = [];
    for (let i2 = 0; i2 < 8; i2++) {
      const a2 = i2 / 8 * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 8;
      const gem = new SphereGeometry(0.045, 12, 10);
      gem.translate(Math.cos(a2) * 0.52, 0.17, Math.sin(a2) * 0.52);
      (i2 % 2 === 0 ? gemA : gemB).push(gem);
    }
    const ruby = new Mesh(mergeGeometries(gemA, false), new MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 14753096,
      metalness: 0.1,
      roughness: 0.12
    }));
    const sapphire = new Mesh(mergeGeometries(gemB, false), new MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 2450411,
      metalness: 0.1,
      roughness: 0.12
    }));
    group.add(ruby, sapphire);
    const velvet = new Mesh(
      new CylinderGeometry(0.46, 0.46, 0.3, 32, 1, true),
      new MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 8330525, roughness: 0.9, side: BackSide })
    );
    velvet.position.y = 0.16;
    group.add(velvet);
    return group;
  }

  function makeFace2DTexture(draw) {
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = 512;
    canvas.height = 512;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    draw(ctx, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const texture = new CanvasTexture(canvas);
    texture.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace;
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
  }
  function getOpenArtImage(url) {
    if (openArtImageCache[url]) return openArtImageCache[url];
    openArtImageCache[url] = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      if (/^https?:/i.test(url)) image.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        delete openArtImageCache[url];
        image.src = "";
        reject(new Error("Timed out loading open AR asset: " + url));
      }, 5e3);
      image.onload = () => {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        resolve(image);
      };
      image.onerror = () => {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        delete openArtImageCache[url];
        reject(new Error("Could not load open AR asset: " + url));
      };
      image.src = url;
    });
    return openArtImageCache[url];
  }
  function makeOpenArtTexture(url, options = {}) {
    return getOpenArtImage(url).then((image) => makeFace2DTexture((ctx, w3, h2) => {
      const crop = options.crop;
      const logicalSize = options.logicalSize;
      const scaleX = logicalSize ? image.naturalWidth / logicalSize[0] : 1;
      const scaleY = logicalSize ? image.naturalHeight / logicalSize[1] : 1;
      const sx = crop ? crop[0] * scaleX : 0;
      const sy = crop ? crop[1] * scaleY : 0;
      const sw = crop ? crop[2] * scaleX : image.naturalWidth;
      const sh = crop ? crop[3] * scaleY : image.naturalHeight;
      ctx.drawImage(image, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, w3, h2);
      if (!options.keep) return;
      const pixels = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w3, h2);
      for (let i2 = 0; i2 < pixels.data.length; i2 += 4) {
        const r2 = pixels.data[i2], g3 = pixels.data[i2 + 1], b2 = pixels.data[i2 + 2];
        let preserve = false;
        if (options.keep === "ink") {
          preserve = Math.max(r2, g3, b2) < 145;
        } else if (options.keep === "silver") {
          preserve = Math.abs(r2 - g3) < 24 && Math.abs(g3 - b2) < 24 && r2 > 108;
        } else if (options.keep === "warmInk") {
          preserve = r2 > 92 && g3 > 45 && g3 < 190 && b2 < 105 && r2 > b2 + 40;
        }
        if (!preserve) pixels.data[i2 + 3] = 0;
      }
      ctx.putImageData(pixels, 0, 0);
    }));
  }
  function createFace2DSprite(texture, opacity = 1) {
    const material = new SpriteMaterial({
      map: texture,
      transparent: true,
      depthWrite: false,
      depthTest: false,
      opacity
    });
    const sprite = new Sprite(material);
    sprite.renderOrder = 20;
    face2DRoot.add(sprite);
    return sprite;
  }
  function circle(ctx, x2, y2, r2, fill) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x2, y2, r2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = fill;
    ctx.fill();
  }
  function catEarTexture() {
    return makeFace2DTexture((ctx, w3, h2) => {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(w3 / 2, h2 / 2);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-w3 * 0.38, h2 * 0.34);
      ctx.lineTo(0, -h2 * 0.42);
      ctx.lineTo(w3 * 0.38, h2 * 0.34);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#F59E0B";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth = w3 * 0.045;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#7C2D12";
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-w3 * 0.19, h2 * 0.22);
      ctx.lineTo(0, -h2 * 0.24);
      ctx.lineTo(w3 * 0.19, h2 * 0.22);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#FBCFE8";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    });
  }
  function rabbitEarsTexture() {
    return makeFace2DTexture((ctx, w3, h2) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#F8FAFC";
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#94A3B8";
      ctx.lineWidth = w3 * 0.025;
      for (const x2 of [w3 * 0.28, w3 * 0.72]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(x2, h2 * 0.48, w3 * 0.15, h2 * 0.42, x2 < w3 / 2 ? -0.12 : 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(x2, h2 * 0.48, w3 * 0.07, h2 * 0.3, x2 < w3 / 2 ? -0.12 : 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#FDA4AF";
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = "#F8FAFC";
      }
    });
  }
  function catMuzzleTexture() {
    return makeFace2DTexture((ctx, w3, h2) => {

      circle(ctx, w3 * 0.61, h2 * 0.53, w3 * 0.18, "#FFF7ED");

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#3F2418";
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(w3 * 0.5, h2 * 0.48);
      ctx.lineTo(w3 * 0.5, h2 * 0.67);
      ctx.stroke();
      circle(ctx, w3 * 0.5, h2 * 0.42, w3 * 0.1, "#3F2418");
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        for (const y2 of [0.51, 0.64]) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(w3 * 0.44, h2 * y2);
          ctx.lineTo(w3 * (0.44 + side * 0.42), h2 * (y2 + (y2 < 0.6 ? -0.06 : 0.04)));
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function grandpaHairTexture() {
    return makeFace2DTexture((ctx, w3, h2) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(226,232,240,0.94)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(w3 * 0.04, h2 * 0.75);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(w3 * 0.1, h2 * 0.08, w3 * 0.9, h2 * 0.08, w3 * 0.96, h2 * 0.75);
      ctx.lineTo(w3 * 0.84, h2 * 0.67);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(w3 * 0.7, h2 * 0.45, w3 * 0.3, h2 * 0.45, w3 * 0.16, h2 * 0.67);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(100,116,139,0.75)";
      ctx.lineWidth = w3 * 0.018;
      for (let i2 = 0; i2 < 10; i2++) {
        const x2 = w3 * (0.13 + i2 * 0.082);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x2, h2 * 0.23);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x2 + w3 * 0.06, h2 * 0.42, x2 - w3 * 0.01, h2 * 0.62);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });
  }
  function clearFace2DFilter() {
    activeFace2DFilter = null;
    face2DParts = null;
    face2DRoot.visible = false;
    face2DSmooth.fresh = true;
    while (face2DRoot.children.length) {
      const child = face2DRoot.children[0];
      face2DRoot.remove(child);
      if (child.material) {
        if (child.material.map) child.material.map.dispose();
        child.material.dispose();
      }
    }
  }
  async function activateFace2DFilter(id) {
    clearFace2DFilter();
    activeFace2DFilter = id;
    let textures;
    try {
      if (id === "cat_ears") {
        textures = await Promise.all([
          makeOpenArtTexture(OPEN_AR_ART.catEars),
          // The Noto cat's original ink (nose, mouth, whiskers) is extracted
          // from its face artwork; no yellow face fill is pasted over a child.
          makeOpenArtTexture(OPEN_AR_ART.catFace, { crop: [0, 70, 128, 36], keep: "ink", logicalSize: [128, 128] })
        ]);
      } else if (id === "rabbit_ears") {
        textures = await Promise.all([
          // Each Noto ear gets its own landmark-driven sprite. Independent
          // rotation makes the little ear wiggle readable and avoids stretching
          // one wide crop into a static headband.
          makeOpenArtTexture(OPEN_AR_ART.rabbitFace, { crop: [27, 1, 35, 61], logicalSize: [128, 128] }),
          makeOpenArtTexture(OPEN_AR_ART.rabbitFace, { crop: [66, 1, 35, 61], logicalSize: [128, 128] }),
          makeOpenArtTexture(OPEN_AR_ART.rabbitFace, { crop: [47, 84, 34, 34], keep: "ink", logicalSize: [128, 128] })
        ]);
      } else if (id === "glasses") {
        textures = await Promise.all([
          makeOpenArtTexture(OPEN_AR_ART.glasses, { crop: [46, 182, 712, 226], logicalSize: [800, 600] })
        ]);
      } else if (id === "grandpa") {
        textures = await Promise.all([
          // Silver-only selection from Noto's old-man hair leaves skin pixels
          // transparent while keeping the visibly white/grey hair strands.
          makeOpenArtTexture(OPEN_AR_ART.oldManFace, { crop: [6, 25, 116, 58], keep: "silver", logicalSize: [128, 128] })
        ]);
      }
    } catch (e2) {
      if (id === "cat_ears") textures = [catEarTexture(), catMuzzleTexture()];
      else if (id === "rabbit_ears") {
        const fallbackEars = rabbitEarsTexture();
        textures = [fallbackEars, fallbackEars.clone(), rabbitMuzzleTexture()];
        textures[1].needsUpdate = true;
      } else if (id === "glasses") textures = [glassesTexture()];
      else if (id === "grandpa") textures = [grandpaHairTexture()];
    }
    if (isDestroyed() || activeFace2DFilter !== id || !textures) {
      for (const texture of textures || []) texture.dispose();
      return false;
    }
    if (id === "cat_ears") {
      face2DParts = { ears: createFace2DSprite(textures[0]), muzzle: createFace2DSprite(textures[1]) };
    } else if (id === "rabbit_ears") {
      face2DParts = {
        earLeft: createFace2DSprite(textures[0]),
        earRight: createFace2DSprite(textures[1]),
        muzzle: createFace2DSprite(textures[2])
      };
    } else if (id === "glasses") {
      face2DParts = { glasses: createFace2DSprite(textures[0]) };
    } else if (id === "grandpa") {
      face2DParts = { hair: createFace2DSprite(textures[0], 0.96) };
    }
    return true;
  }
  function placeFace2DSprite(sprite, x2, y2, width, height, rotation = 0, opacity = 1) {
    sprite.position.set(x2, y2, 1);
    sprite.scale.set(width, height, 1);
    sprite.material.rotation = rotation;
    sprite.material.opacity = opacity;
  }
  function updateFace2DFilter(landmarks) {
    if (!activeFace2DFilter || !face2DParts) return;
    lmToScreen(landmarks[LM.templeL], face2DRaw.templeL);
    lmToScreen(landmarks[LM.templeR], face2DRaw.templeR);
    lmToScreen(landmarks[LM.eyeOuterL], face2DRaw.eyeL);
    lmToScreen(landmarks[LM.eyeOuterR], face2DRaw.eyeR);
    lmToScreen(landmarks[LM.forehead], face2DRaw.forehead);
    lmToScreen(landmarks[LM.noseTip], face2DRaw.nose);
    lmToScreen(landmarks[LM.chin], face2DRaw.chin);
    for (const key of ["templeL", "templeR", "eyeL", "eyeR", "forehead", "nose", "chin"]) {
      if (face2DSmooth.fresh) face2DSmooth[key].copy(face2DRaw[key]);
      else face2DSmooth[key].lerp(face2DRaw[key], 0.42);
    }
    face2DSmooth.fresh = false;
    face2DRoot.visible = true;
    const faceWidth = Math.max(1, Math.hypot(
      face2DSmooth.templeR.x - face2DSmooth.templeL.x,
      face2DSmooth.templeR.y - face2DSmooth.templeL.y
    ));
    let roll = Math.atan2(
      face2DSmooth.eyeR.y - face2DSmooth.eyeL.y,
      face2DSmooth.eyeR.x - face2DSmooth.eyeL.x
    );
    if (roll > Math.PI / 2) roll -= Math.PI;
    if (roll < -Math.PI / 2) roll += Math.PI;
    const forehead = face2DSmooth.forehead;
    const nose = face2DSmooth.nose;
    const eyeCenter = _face2DA.copy(face2DSmooth.eyeL).add(face2DSmooth.eyeR).multiplyScalar(0.5);
    const bounce = Math.sin(performance.now() * 6e-3) * faceWidth * 0.018;
    if (activeFace2DFilter === "cat_ears") {
      placeFace2DSprite(face2DParts.ears, forehead.x, forehead.y + faceWidth * 0.22 + bounce, faceWidth * 1.04, faceWidth * 0.39, roll);
      placeFace2DSprite(face2DParts.muzzle, nose.x, nose.y - faceWidth * 0.055, faceWidth * 0.84, faceWidth * 0.24, roll);
    } else if (activeFace2DFilter === "rabbit_ears") {
      const smile = smileAmount();
      const jawOpen = getBlendshape("jawOpen");
      const blink = Math.max(getBlendshape("eyeBlinkLeft"), getBlendshape("eyeBlinkRight"));
      const expression = Math.max(smile, jawOpen, blink);
      const wiggle = Math.sin(performance.now() * 9e-3) * 0.055 + expression * 0.12;
      const earY = forehead.y + faceWidth * (0.36 + smile * 0.08) + bounce;
      placeFace2DSprite(face2DParts.earLeft, forehead.x - faceWidth * 0.22, earY, faceWidth * 0.34, faceWidth * 0.72, roll - wiggle);
      placeFace2DSprite(face2DParts.earRight, forehead.x + faceWidth * 0.22, earY, faceWidth * 0.34, faceWidth * 0.72, roll + wiggle);
      placeFace2DSprite(
        face2DParts.muzzle,
        nose.x,
        nose.y - faceWidth * (0.07 + jawOpen * 0.025),
        faceWidth * (0.44 + smile * 0.04),
        faceWidth * (0.34 + jawOpen * 0.09),
        roll
      );
    } else if (activeFace2DFilter === "glasses") {
      placeFace2DSprite(face2DParts.glasses, eyeCenter.x, eyeCenter.y, faceWidth * 0.94, faceWidth * 0.3, roll);
    } else if (activeFace2DFilter === "grandpa") {
      placeFace2DSprite(face2DParts.hair, forehead.x, forehead.y + faceWidth * 0.19 + bounce * 0.35, faceWidth * 1.2, faceWidth * 0.55, roll, 0.94);
    }
  }
  var CANONICAL = window.__CANONICAL_FACE__;
  var AGING_VERTS = CANONICAL.landmarkIndex.length;
  var agingMesh = null;
  var agingMaterial = null;
  var wrinkleMaskTexture = null;

  function computeOpenTriangles(fullSlotTriangles, landmarkIndex) {
    const kept = [];
    let mouthRemoved = 0;
    let leftEyeRemoved = 0;
    let rightEyeRemoved = 0;
    for (let i2 = 0; i2 < fullSlotTriangles.length; i2 += 3) {
      const s0 = fullSlotTriangles[i2];
      const s1 = fullSlotTriangles[i2 + 1];
      const s2 = fullSlotTriangles[i2 + 2];
      const l0 = landmarkIndex[s0];
      const l1 = landmarkIndex[s1];
      const l2 = landmarkIndex[s2];
      if (CAP_RING_MOUTH.has(l0) && CAP_RING_MOUTH.has(l1) && CAP_RING_MOUTH.has(l2)) {
        mouthRemoved++;
        continue;
      }
      if (CAP_RING_LEFT_EYE.has(l0) && CAP_RING_LEFT_EYE.has(l1) && CAP_RING_LEFT_EYE.has(l2)) {
        leftEyeRemoved++;
        continue;
      }
      if (CAP_RING_RIGHT_EYE.has(l0) && CAP_RING_RIGHT_EYE.has(l1) && CAP_RING_RIGHT_EYE.has(l2)) {
        rightEyeRemoved++;
        continue;
      }
      kept.push(s0, s1, s2);
    }
    return {
      triangles: kept,
      fullCount: fullSlotTriangles.length / 3,
      keptCount: kept.length / 3,
      mouthRemoved,
      leftEyeRemoved,
      rightEyeRemoved,
      totalRemoved: mouthRemoved + leftEyeRemoved + rightEyeRemoved
    };
  }
  function glErrorName(gl, code) {
    const names = {};
    names[gl.NO_ERROR] = "NO_ERROR";
    names[gl.INVALID_ENUM] = "INVALID_ENUM";
    names[gl.INVALID_VALUE] = "INVALID_VALUE";
    names[gl.INVALID_OPERATION] = "INVALID_OPERATION";
    names[gl.INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION] = "INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION";
    names[gl.OUT_OF_MEMORY] = "OUT_OF_MEMORY";
    if (gl.CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL !== void 0) names[gl.CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL] = "CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL";
    return names[code] || "UNKNOWN(" + code + ")";
  }
  function compileDiagnostic(gl, vertSrc, fragSrc) {
    const report = { vertexOk: false, fragmentOk: false, linked: false, vertexLog: "", fragmentLog: "", programLog: "" };
    const vs2 = gl.createShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER);
    gl.shaderSource(vs2, vertSrc);
    gl.compileShader(vs2);
    report.vertexOk = !!gl.getShaderParameter(vs2, gl.COMPILE_STATUS);
    report.vertexLog = gl.getShaderInfoLog(vs2) || "";
    const fs2 = gl.createShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER);
    gl.shaderSource(fs2, fragSrc);
    gl.compileShader(fs2);
    report.fragmentOk = !!gl.getShaderParameter(fs2, gl.COMPILE_STATUS);
    report.fragmentLog = gl.getShaderInfoLog(fs2) || "";
    const prog = gl.createProgram();
    gl.attachShader(prog, vs2);
    gl.attachShader(prog, fs2);
    gl.linkProgram(prog);
    report.linked = !!gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.LINK_STATUS);
    report.programLog = gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog) || "";
    gl.deleteProgram(prog);
    gl.deleteShader(vs2);
    gl.deleteShader(fs2);
    return report;
  }

  function canonicalNormals(indexTriangles) {
    const n2 = new Float32Array(468 * 3);
    const pa2 = new Vector3(), pb = new Vector3(), pc2 = new Vector3();
    const ab4 = new Vector3(), ac3 = new Vector3(), fn2 = new Vector3();
    for (let i2 = 0; i2 < indexTriangles.length; i2 += 3) {
      const s0 = indexTriangles[i2], s1 = indexTriangles[i2 + 1], s2 = indexTriangles[i2 + 2];
      canonPos(s0, pa2);
      canonPos(s1, pb);
      canonPos(s2, pc2);
      ab4.subVectors(pb, pa2);
      ac3.subVectors(pc2, pa2);
      fn2.crossVectors(ab4, ac3);
      for (const s3 of [s0, s1, s2]) {
        n2[s3 * 3] += fn2.x;
        n2[s3 * 3 + 1] += fn2.y;
        n2[s3 * 3 + 2] += fn2.z;
      }
    }
    const v3 = new Vector3();
    for (let s2 = 0; s2 < 468; s2++) {
      v3.set(n2[s2 * 3], n2[s2 * 3 + 1], n2[s2 * 3 + 2]);
      if (v3.z < 0) v3.negate();
      v3.normalize();
      n2[s2 * 3] = v3.x;
      n2[s2 * 3 + 1] = v3.y;
      n2[s2 * 3 + 2] = v3.z;
    }
    return n2;
  }
  function smoothFalloff(d2, radius) {
    const t2 = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, d2 / radius));
    return 1 - t2 * t2 * (3 - 2 * t2);
  }
  function buildMorphOffsets(effects, indexTriangles) {
    const edgeCount = {};
    for (let i2 = 0; i2 < indexTriangles.length; i2 += 3) {
      const t0 = indexTriangles[i2], t1 = indexTriangles[i2 + 1], t2 = indexTriangles[i2 + 2];
      for (const [a2, b2] of [[t0, t1], [t1, t2], [t2, t0]]) {
        const key = a2 < b2 ? a2 + "_" + b2 : b2 + "_" + a2;
        edgeCount[key] = (edgeCount[key] || 0) + 1;
      }
    }
    const boundarySlots = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    for (const key of Object.keys(edgeCount)) {
      if (edgeCount[key] === 1) {
        const parts = key.split("_");
        boundarySlots.add(parseInt(parts[0], 10));
        boundarySlots.add(parseInt(parts[1], 10));
      }
    }
    const normals = canonicalNormals(indexTriangles);
    const vp = new Vector3(), cp = new Vector3(), acc = new Vector3(), dir = new Vector3();
    const eyeCenters = [];
    for (const ring of [CAP_RING_LEFT_EYE, CAP_RING_RIGHT_EYE]) {
      const c2 = new Vector3();
      let count = 0;
      ring.forEach((lm) => {
        if (SLOT_OF_LANDMARK[lm] !== void 0) {
          c2.add(canonPos(SLOT_OF_LANDMARK[lm], cp));
          count++;
        }
      });
      if (count) eyeCenters.push(c2.multiplyScalar(1 / count));
    }
    const nostrilSlots = [SLOT_OF_LANDMARK[129], SLOT_OF_LANDMARK[358]];
    const protection = new Float32Array(468);
    for (let s2 = 0; s2 < 468; s2++) {
      canonPos(s2, vp);
      let minBoundary = Infinity;
      boundarySlots.forEach((bs2) => {
        const d2 = vp.distanceTo(canonPos(bs2, cp));
        if (d2 < minBoundary) minBoundary = d2;
      });
      let prot = 1 - smoothFalloff(minBoundary, 0.9);
      for (const ec2 of eyeCenters) prot *= 1 - smoothFalloff(vp.distanceTo(ec2), 1.7);
      for (const ns2 of nostrilSlots) prot *= 1 - smoothFalloff(vp.distanceTo(canonPos(ns2, cp)), 0.7);
      protection[s2] = prot;
    }
    const out = new Float32Array(468 * 3);
    for (const effect of effects) {
      const ampCm = effect.ampMm / 10;
      const centerSlots = effect.centers.map((lm) => SLOT_OF_LANDMARK[lm]).filter((s2) => s2 !== void 0);
      for (let s2 = 0; s2 < 468; s2++) {
        if (protection[s2] <= 1e-3) continue;
        canonPos(s2, vp);
        let minD = Infinity;
        for (const cs2 of centerSlots) {
          const d2 = vp.distanceTo(canonPos(cs2, cp));
          if (d2 < minD) minD = d2;
        }
        const w3 = smoothFalloff(minD, effect.radiusCm) * protection[s2];
        if (w3 <= 1e-3) continue;
        if (effect.dir === "down") dir.set(0, -1, 0);
        else {
          dir.set(normals[s2 * 3], normals[s2 * 3 + 1], normals[s2 * 3 + 2]);
          if (effect.dir === "in") dir.negate();
        }
        out[s2 * 3] += dir.x * ampCm * w3;
        out[s2 * 3 + 1] += dir.y * ampCm * w3;
        out[s2 * 3 + 2] += dir.z * ampCm * w3;
      }
    }
    let maxDisp = 0, affected = 0;
    for (let s2 = 0; s2 < 468; s2++) {
      acc.set(out[s2 * 3], out[s2 * 3 + 1], out[s2 * 3 + 2]);
      const len = acc.length();
      if (len > 0.4) {
        acc.multiplyScalar(0.4 / len);
        out[s2 * 3] = acc.x;
        out[s2 * 3 + 1] = acc.y;
        out[s2 * 3 + 2] = acc.z;
      }
      if (len > 5e-3) affected++;
      if (len > maxDisp) maxDisp = Math.min(len, 0.4);
    }
    return { offsets: out, maxDispMm: maxDisp * 10, affectedVerts: affected, boundaryVerts: boundarySlots.size };
  }

  function ensureAgingMesh() {
    if (agingMesh) return;
    try {
      let indexTriangles = CANONICAL.triangles;
      let topologyPreview = null;
      if (DEBUG_TOPOLOGY_PREVIEW && CANONICAL.trianglesFull) {
        topologyPreview = computeOpenTriangles(CANONICAL.trianglesFull, CANONICAL.landmarkIndex);
        indexTriangles = topologyPreview.triangles;
      }
      const geo = new BufferGeometry();
      geo.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(agingPositions, 3));
      geo.setAttribute("uv", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(CANONICAL.uv), 2));
      geo.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(new Uint16Array(indexTriangles), 1));
      const morphBuild = buildMorphOffsets(GRANDPA_MORPH, indexTriangles);
      geo.setAttribute("morph", new BufferAttribute(morphBuild.offsets, 3));
      const vertexShader = [
        "precision mediump float;",
        "attribute vec3 position;",
        "attribute vec2 uv;",
        "attribute vec3 morph;",
        "uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;",
        "uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;",
        "uniform vec3 uMorphRight;",
        "uniform vec3 uMorphUp;",
        "uniform vec3 uMorphFwd;",
        "uniform float uMorphScale;",
        "varying vec2 vUv;",
        "varying vec2 vScreenPos;",
        "void main() {",
        "  vUv = uv;",
        "  // vScreenPos = the UNDEFORMED tracked position: the fragment shader",
        "  // samples the live camera there and draws those pixels at the",
        "  // DEFORMED position below \u2014 that is what makes the geometric aging",
        "  // actually move the user's own face pixels (mesh-warp), instead of",
        "  // only moving an invisible overlay. Boundary vertices have zero",
        "  // morph, so the warped face blends seamlessly into the un-warped",
        "  // video around it.",
        "  vScreenPos = position.xy;",
        "  vec3 displaced = position + (uMorphRight * morph.x + uMorphUp * morph.y + uMorphFwd * morph.z) * uMorphScale;",
        "  gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(displaced, 1.0);",
        "}"
      ].join("\n");
      const fragmentShader = [
        "precision mediump float;",
        "uniform sampler2D wrinkleMask;",
        "uniform sampler2D detailMap;",
        "uniform sampler2D cameraMap;",
        "uniform float uCoverScale;",
        "uniform float uCropX;",
        "uniform float uCropY;",
        "uniform float uVideoW;",
        "uniform float uVideoH;",
        "uniform float uScreenW;",
        "uniform float uMirror;",
        "uniform float wrinkleStrength;",
        "uniform float wrinkleScale;",
        "uniform float wrinkleSharpness;",
        "uniform float wrinkleDarkness;",
        "uniform float wrinkleHighlight;",
        "uniform float ageAmount;",
        "uniform float wrinkleDebugMode;",
        "varying vec2 vUv;",
        "varying vec2 vScreenPos;",
        "",
        "// Soft 1-inside/0-outside mask, used to keep creases off the eyes,",
        "// nostrils and mouth. The same exclusions are ALSO baked into the",
        "// mask texture \u2014 this in-shader copy is belt-and-suspenders for the",
        "// boundary pixels right at the edge of the real mesh holes.",
        "float ellipseMask(vec2 uv, vec2 center, vec2 radius, float feather) {",
        "  vec2 d = (uv - center) / radius;",
        "  float r = length(d);",
        "  return 1.0 - smoothstep(1.0 - feather, 1.0, r);",
        "}",
        "void main() {",
        "  vec2 uv = vUv;",
        "  // Feather the face-warp boundary into the unchanged camera plane.",
        "  // A hard opaque edge is what produced the dark helmet-like arc at",
        "  // the hairline in the device screenshot.",
        "  float faceFeather = ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.5, 0.486), vec2(0.495, 0.421), 0.20);",
        "  // Live camera pixels at the UNDEFORMED tracked position \u2014 replayed",
        "  // at the deformed one (mesh-warp). Inverse of lmToScreen's cover",
        "  // crop + selfie mirror.",
        "  float sx = vScreenPos.x;",
        "  float sy = -vScreenPos.y;",
        "  if (uMirror > 0.5) sx = uScreenW - sx;",
        "  vec2 vidUv = vec2((sx + uCropX) / (uCoverScale * uVideoW), (sy + uCropY) / (uCoverScale * uVideoH));",
        "  vec3 cam = texture2D(cameraMap, vidUv).rgb;",
        "  vec3 mask = texture2D(wrinkleMask, uv).rgb;",
        "",
        "  // wrinkleSharpness reshapes the baked falloff: >1 tightens the",
        "  // crease core (gamma < 1 on the mask), <1 spreads it softer.",
        "  float shape = 1.0 / max(0.35, wrinkleSharpness);",
        "  float dark = pow(mask.r, shape);",
        "  float light = pow(mask.g, shape);",
        "  float spots = mask.b;",
        "",
        "  // Domain-warped tiling: two decorrelated low-frequency samples of the",
        "  // detail map perturb the pore-sampling coordinates, so the 256px tile",
        "  // never lines up with itself \u2014 repeated tiling stops being readable.",
        "  vec2 warp = vec2(",
        "    texture2D(detailMap, uv * 1.3 + 0.13).r,",
        "    texture2D(detailMap, uv * 1.3 + 0.71).r",
        "  ) - 0.5;",
        "  // Tiling skin-detail texture: fine pores (warped) + two slower blotch",
        "  // fields. blotch varies crease intensity along their length; blotch2",
        "  // drives the warm/cool skin mottling below.",
        "  float pores = texture2D(detailMap, uv * 12.0 * wrinkleScale + warp * 0.6).r;",
        "  float blotch = texture2D(detailMap, uv * 3.0 * wrinkleScale + 0.37).r;",
        "  float blotch2 = texture2D(detailMap, uv * 2.2 * wrinkleScale + vec2(0.61, 0.17)).r;",
        "  float variation = 0.55 + 0.45 * blotch;",
        "  dark *= variation;",
        "  light *= variation;",
        "",
        "  dark *= ageAmount;",
        "  light *= ageAmount;",
        "  spots *= ageAmount;",
        "",
        "  float protect = 0.0;",
        "  protect = max(protect, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.3496, 0.6186), vec2(0.115, 0.068), 0.4));",
        "  protect = max(protect, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.6504, 0.6186), vec2(0.115, 0.068), 0.4));",
        "  protect = max(protect, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.397, 0.4512), vec2(0.038, 0.030), 0.4));",
        "  protect = max(protect, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.603, 0.4513), vec2(0.038, 0.030), 0.4));",
        "  protect = max(protect, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.5, 0.305), vec2(0.150, 0.105), 0.4));",
        "  dark *= (1.0 - protect);",
        "  light *= (1.0 - protect);",
        "  spots *= (1.0 - protect);",
        "",
        "  // Aged-skin zones: wide, heavily-feathered ellipses over forehead,",
        "  // cheeks and chin (computed procedurally, not from the mask texture,",
        "  // to keep the PNG alpha channel at 255 everywhere \u2014 low/zero PNG",
        "  // alpha risks premultiplication precision loss of the RGB data",
        "  // channels on some WebView decoders). This zone carries the overall",
        "  // aged-texture and mottling below at very low alpha.",
        "  float aged = 0.0;",
        "  aged = max(aged, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.5, 0.80), vec2(0.30, 0.13), 0.7));",
        "  aged = max(aged, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.30, 0.45), vec2(0.13, 0.11), 0.7));",
        "  aged = max(aged, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.70, 0.45), vec2(0.13, 0.11), 0.7));",
        "  aged = max(aged, ellipseMask(uv, vec2(0.5, 0.14), vec2(0.15, 0.10), 0.7));",
        "  aged *= (1.0 - protect);",
        "  aged *= ageAmount;",
        "",
        "  if (wrinkleDebugMode > 0.5) {",
        "    float m = clamp(max(max(dark, light), spots), 0.0, 1.0);",
        "    gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(m), faceFeather);",
        "    return;",
        "  }",
        "",
        "  // Clamp AFTER applying wrinkleStrength (not before) \u2014 with",
        "  // wrinkleStrength above 1.0 the pre-clamp product can exceed 1.0,",
        "  // which would push the color mixes below past their endpoint colors",
        "  // into overshoot/negative-channel extrapolation.",
        "  float darkA = clamp(dark * wrinkleDarkness * wrinkleStrength, 0.0, 1.0);",
        "  float lightA = clamp(light * wrinkleHighlight * wrinkleStrength, 0.0, 1.0);",
        "",
        "  // Pore grain around creases, age spots AND the aged-skin zones",
        "  // (amplitude +30 percent over the previous build per tuning request).",
        "  float active = clamp(max(max(max(dark, light), spots * 0.8), aged * 0.55) * 3.0, 0.0, 1.0);",
        "  float micro = (pores - 0.5) * 0.13 * active;",
        "  darkA = clamp(darkA + max(0.0, micro), 0.0, 1.0);",
        "  lightA = clamp(lightA + max(0.0, -micro), 0.0, 1.0);",
        "",
        "  // Age spots: translucent warm-brown pigmentation, edges broken up by",
        "  // the blotch field so they read as skin, not stickers.",
        "  float spotA = clamp(spots * 0.45 * wrinkleStrength * (0.7 + 0.3 * blotch), 0.0, 1.0);",
        "",
        "  // Aged-skin base layer: very subtle warm/cool mottling + grain inside",
        "  // the aged zones, capped at 0.14 alpha so the live camera always",
        '  // dominates \u2014 this is what shifts the read from "young skin with',
        '  // lines drawn on" to "aged skin".',
        "  float mottle = blotch2 - 0.5;",
        "  vec3 warmTint = vec3(0.80, 0.62, 0.50);",
        "  vec3 coolTint = vec3(0.62, 0.64, 0.70);",
        "  vec3 skinTint = mix(coolTint, warmTint, clamp(0.5 + mottle * 1.6, 0.0, 1.0));",
        "  float skinA = aged * (0.05 + 0.10 * abs(mottle) * 2.0 + 0.06 * abs(pores - 0.5) * 2.0);",
        "  skinA = min(skinA * clamp(wrinkleStrength * 0.6, 0.0, 1.0), 0.14);",
        "",
        "  // Warm skin-tone colors \u2014 never black or white. Shadow is a muted",
        "  // brown a shade darker than skin (ambient-occlusion tint, not ink);",
        "  // highlight is a faint warm sheen; spots sit between the two.",
        "  vec3 shadowColor = vec3(0.42, 0.30, 0.24);",
        "  vec3 ridgeColor = vec3(0.92, 0.82, 0.70);",
        "  vec3 spotColor = vec3(0.55, 0.42, 0.30);",
        "  // Layered over-composite, bottom to top: mottled skin base, ridge",
        "  // highlight, age spots, crease shadow.",
        "  vec3 outColor = skinTint;",
        "  float outAlpha = skinA;",
        "  outColor = mix(outColor, ridgeColor, lightA);",
        "  outAlpha = lightA + outAlpha * (1.0 - lightA);",
        "  outColor = mix(outColor, spotColor, spotA);",
        "  outAlpha = spotA + outAlpha * (1.0 - spotA);",
        "  outColor = mix(outColor, shadowColor, darkA);",
        "  outAlpha = darkA + outAlpha * (1.0 - darkA);",
        "  // Composite the wrinkle overlay onto the WARPED camera pixels and",
        "  // output opaque \u2014 inside the mesh we now REPLACE the background",
        "  // video (that replacement is the visible geometric aging).",
        "  vec3 finalColor = mix(cam, outColor, outAlpha);",
        "  gl_FragColor = vec4(finalColor, faceFeather);",
        "}"
      ].join("\n");
      const gl = renderer.getContext();
      const shaderDiag = compileDiagnostic(gl, vertexShader, fragmentShader);
      const glErrorAfterCompile = glErrorName(gl, gl.getError());
      const texLoader = new TextureLoader();
      const texLoaded = (name) => (tex) => {
        rnPost({ type: "diag", stage: "wrinkle-texture-loaded", texture: name, width: tex.image.width, height: tex.image.height });
      };
      const texFailed = (name) => () => {
        rnPost({ type: "error", message: "wrinkle texture failed to load: " + name });
      };

  function detectFrame() {
    if (isDestroyed() || !faceLandmarker) return;
    frameCount += 1;
    if (frameCount % PROCESS_EVERY !== 0) return;

    if (!image) return;

    try {
      latestResult = faceLandmarker.detectForVideo(image, detectTimestamp);
    } catch (e2) {
      return;
    }
    const found = !!(latestResult && latestResult.faceLandmarks && latestResult.faceLandmarks.length);
    latestLandmarks = found ? latestResult.faceLandmarks[0] : null;

      if (found) rig.fresh = true;
      rnPost({ type: "tracking", found });
    }
  }

  function ensureAudioCtx() {
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if (audioCtx.state === "suspended") audioCtx.resume();
    return audioCtx;
  }
  function compositeFrame() {
    if (!compositeCtx) return;
    const w3 = compositeCanvas.width, h2 = compositeCanvas.height;
    const vw = videoEl.videoWidth, vh = videoEl.videoHeight;
    if (!vw || !vh) return;
    const videoAspect = vw / vh;
    const outAspect = w3 / h2;
    let sw, sh, sx, sy;
    if (videoAspect > outAspect) {
      sh = vh;
      sw = sh * outAspect;
      sx = (vw - sw) / 2;
      sy = 0;
    } else {
      sw = vw;
      sh = sw / outAspect;
      sx = 0;
      sy = (vh - sh) / 2;
    }
    if (agingBackdrop && agingBackdrop.visible) {
    } else if (facing === "user") {
      compositeCtx.save();
      compositeCtx.scale(-1, 1);
      compositeCtx.drawImage(videoEl, sx, sy, sw, sh, -w3, 0, w3, h2);
      compositeCtx.restore();
    } else {
      compositeCtx.drawImage(videoEl, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, w3, h2);
    }
    compositeCtx.drawImage(renderer.domElement, 0, 0, w3, h2);
  }
  function pickMime() {
    const candidates = ["video/mp4;codecs=avc1", "video/mp4", "video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus", "video/webm"];
    for (const c2 of candidates) {
      try {
        if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(c2)) return c2;
      } catch (e2) {
      }
    }
    return "";
  }
  async function startRecording() {
    if (recorder || isDestroyed()) return;
    try {
      const scaleDown = TIER === 2 ? 1 : 1.5;
      compositeCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      compositeCanvas.width = Math.round(720 / scaleDown);
      compositeCanvas.height = Math.round(720 / scaleDown * (H2 / W2));
      compositeCtx = compositeCanvas.getContext("2d");
      compositeStream = compositeCanvas.captureStream(30);
      try {
        micStream = await realGUM({ audio: true });
        if (isDestroyed()) {
          micStream.getTracks().forEach((t2) => t2.stop());
          return;
        }
        const ctx = ensureAudioCtx();
        recDest = ctx.createMediaStreamDestination();
        ctx.createMediaStreamSource(micStream).connect(recDest);
        recDest.stream.getAudioTracks().forEach((t2) => compositeStream.addTrack(t2));
      } catch (e2) {
        rnPost({ type: "error", message: "mic: " + (e2 && e2.message || e2) });
      }
      const mime = pickMime();
      recordedChunks = [];
      recorder = new MediaRecorder(compositeStream, mime ? { mimeType: mime, videoBitsPerSecond: 4e6 } : void 0);
      recorder.ondataavailable = (e2) => {
        if (e2.data && e2.data.size) recordedChunks.push(e2.data);
      };
      recorder.onstop = () => {
        deliverRecording().catch((e2) => rnPost({ type: "error", message: "deliver: " + (e2 && e2.message || e2) }));
      };
      recorder.start(1e3);
      rnPost({ type: "videoStart" });
    } catch (e2) {
      recorder = null;
      rnPost({ type: "error", message: "record-start: " + (e2 && e2.message || e2) });
    }
  }
  function stopRecording() {
    if (!recorder) return;
    try {
      recorder.stop();
    } catch (e2) {
      rnPost({ type: "error", message: "stop: " + (e2 && e2.message || e2) });
    }
  }
  async function deliverRecording() {
    const mime = recorder && recorder.mimeType ? recorder.mimeType : "video/webm";
    recorder = null;
    compositeCtx = null;
    try {
      micStream && micStream.getTracks().forEach((t2) => t2.stop());
    } catch (e2) {
    }
    micStream = null;
    recDest = null;
    const blob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: mime });
    recordedChunks = [];
    if (isDestroyed()) return;
    const buffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
    if (isDestroyed()) return;
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
    let binary = "";
    const SLICE = 32768;
    for (let i2 = 0; i2 < bytes.length; i2 += SLICE) {
      binary += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i2, i2 + SLICE));
    }
    const base64 = btoa(binary);
    const CHUNK = 256 * 1024;
    const total = Math.ceil(base64.length / CHUNK);
    for (let i2 = 0; i2 < total; i2++) {
      if (isDestroyed()) return;
      rnPost({ type: "videoChunk", index: i2, total, data: base64.substr(i2 * CHUNK, CHUNK) });
    }
    rnPost({ type: "videoDone", mime, size: blob.size });
  }
  async function handleMessage(raw) {
    if (isDestroyed()) return;
    let msg;
    try {
      msg = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (e2) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (msg.type === "setAnimal") {
        await showFilter(msg.id);
      } else if (msg.type === "record") {
        if (msg.on) await startRecording();
        else stopRecording();
      } else if (msg.type === "flip") {
        facing = facing === "user" ? "environment" : "user";
        rnPost({ type: "loading", label: "flip" });
        latestLandmarks = null;
        await stopCamera();
        if (isDestroyed()) return;
        await startCamera();
        if (isDestroyed()) return;
        rnPost({ type: "ready" });
      } else if (msg.type === "destroy") {
        await destroyAll();
      }
    } catch (e2) {
      rnPost({ type: "error", message: "message " + msg.type + ": " + (e2 && e2.message || e2) });
    }
  }
  window.__kidtokHandle = handleMessage;
  for (const queued of window.__kidtokQueue) handleMessage(queued);
  window.__kidtokQueue = [];
  startAR();
